name: dimension-membership-predicates
description: categorical IN, NOT IN and region membership filters

queries.name: category-list
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE category IN ('books', 'games')

queries.name: excluded-categories
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE category NOT IN ('music', 'food')

queries.name: regional-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE region IN ('EU', 'NA')
